title: Liver disease:
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
Treatment of Tuberculosis in Special Cases

blocks.text: Most of anti-TB medicines can cause liver damage. In case a patient develops jaundice, treatment should be stopped and restarted as soon as the jaundice resolves. In severely ill patients, start moxifloxacin and ethambutol only.
